## Question 1

```{r}
birthdays = sample(1:365, size = 5, replace = TRUE)

repeated_birthdays = length(unique(birthdays)) < 5

repeated_birthdays
```

```{r}
birthday_repeated(147)
```

```{r}
birthday_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 5:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )
```

```{r}
birthday_results_df |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line()
```

## Question 2

Dataframe and reading each file

```{r, message = FALSE}
df =
  tibble(
    file_name = list.files("data/")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    file_path = str_c("data/", file_name),
    data = map(file_path, read_csv)
  ) |> 
  unnest(data)
```

Tidying data

```{r, message = FALSE}
tidy_df =
  df |> 
  mutate(file_name = str_remove(file_name, ".csv")) |> 
  separate(file_name, into = c("arm", "subject_id"), sep = "_") |> 
  mutate(
    arm = case_match(
      arm,
      "con" ~ "control",
      "exp" ~ "experimental"
    ),
    arm = factor(arm),
    unique_id = str_c(arm, "_", subject_id)
  ) |> 
  select(-file_path) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "week_",
    values_to = "observation"
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = as.numeric(week))

tidy_df
```

Spaghetti plot

```{r}
tidy_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = observation, group = unique_id, color = arm)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Observations over time by subject and study arm",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Observation",
    color = "Arm"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
